entities.summary: The Treaty of Teusina was concluded by Russian diplomats under the boyar Afanasiy Pushkin and ambassadors of the Swedish king at the village of Tyavzino in Ingria on 18 May 1595 to end the Russo-Swedish War (1590–1595).
